## Context / Problem
The .github/workflows cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:1-41,85-111,158-162,234-253,282-287,311-336,359-415` — Preserve reconciliation direction, full-history store, signing, pass lock, authoring identity, failure artifacts, single successor scheduling, trusted dispatch inputs, 0/1 CloudWatch contract. Consumer: GitHub Actions/rebar reconciler.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml:3-39,83-114,163-174,300-359,381-393,456-507` — Preserve tag/manual authorization, dependency and metadata gates, build-once artifacts, trusted publishing/attestations, registry validation, evidence fragments. Consumer: GitHub Actions/release operators.
- `.github/workflows/structured-output-baseline.yml:3-16,104-114` — Preserve manual, billable, capped provider matrix; raw outputs and scores; per-test guard. Consumer: GitHub Actions/evaluation operators.
- `.github/workflows/terraform-drift.yml:1-17` — Preserve scheduled/manual read-only plan, no push trigger, OIDC role. Consumer: GitHub Actions/Terraform operators.
- `.github/workflows/test.yml:3-35,61-92,118-151,194-212,229-239,258-282,329-426` — Preserve trigger policy, reusable gates, external-test credential mapping, clean-install probe, health report, exact matrix/platform guarantees, docs link gate. Consumer: GitHub Actions.
- `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml:3-26,47-53,83-88` — Preserve whole-store authenticated authorship, tickets-branch checkout, temporary exception and explicit removal condition. Consumer: GitHub Actions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Every consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] No executable behavior changes; verified by inspecting the final diff and running the command under Verification.
- [ ] No test assertion changes; verified by inspecting the final diff.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
